retired.description: Checkpointless discovery states this round neither reports nor polls; delete them.

BrowserCapture.description: One PNG capture of an owned tab, with the SHA-256 of its decoded bytes.

ChatGptPackageSummary.description:
What the client checked, sent to the coordinator as the import's identity. Bounded and
path-free: part names are file names only.

digest.description: Equal for a ZIP and its extracted folder. The coordinator's single-flight key.

dropped_library_files.description: Library files whose origin is no kept message in this export.

excluded_messages.description:
System, developer, custom-instruction and hidden messages, and code-interpreter outputs of
those kinds, left out on purpose.

notes.description: Repairs and skips that lose no conversation data. Printed, never gaps.

problems.description: Export data that will not be imported. Each becomes an import gap.

unreferenced_files.description: Files in this export that no imported message names.

unsupported.description:
Messages, parts, outputs, attachments and metadata of a kind this import does not read,
counted by label. Each is also an unsupported gap of its conversation; past 32 in one
conversation, the rest are summed in one further gap.

ChatGptUnsupported.description:
How often one kind of export content that this import does not read occurs, such as
`message future_widget` or `part image_asset_pointer (hidden)`. Listed in label order; labels
after the first 32 are summed into one entry whose content is `other`.

GitHubOwnerFilter.description: Partition notifications using repository.full_name, never subject/title text.

oneOf.description:
`request_id` becomes the goal ID, and in main also the new task's ID, so a
replayed set finds the goal it created instead of being refused.

A goal retains the request IDs it accepted, so a replayed pause or resume
changes nothing even after later controls.

GoalTarget.description:
The conversation a `/goal` control addresses. The runtime resolves every form
to main or to exactly one existing task, and refuses an agent conversation.

oneOf.description: The root conversation.

alternates.description:
Sibling subtrees the source kept but did not select at this point. Nonzero only on
current items.

follows.description:
Version of the previous current item. A re-versioned current item therefore
re-versions every later one, and they re-append in path order instead of
aliasing to entries that sit before it.

oneOf.description: On the path from the root to the leaf the source last displayed.
Reachable from a root, on a branch the source did not select.
Unreachable from every root, as in a parent cycle.

branch.description:
Placement in a source's branch tree. Absent for sources without branches and for
items saved before branches existed; readers treat absence as shown.

resume_cursor.description: Durable catch-up position, including EOF, separate from this walk's continuation.

oneOf.description: Assistant text whose source did not identify a semantic phase.
Only ever a reply to a `ReadFile` that carries `image`.
Rex never received the create request, so retrying cannot duplicate a terminal.

delivery.description: Missing on older workers; absence makes no claim about execution.

InputOrigin.description:
Trusted direct-input transport metadata, never inferred from text or host.
Omission is unknown, including legacy clients and non-human work.
`siri` is Siri or a Shortcuts action relayed by the iPhone app. A client sends a value
only when the coordinator lists it in `AcceptedInputOrigins`.

MainInputContext.description: Used only when an idle chief starts a new turn; active work keeps its context.

oneOf.description: Closing this observation detaches the view, not its executor.
Main-only local controls. Never submits a composer input.

Recurrence.description: Canonical DTSTART/RRULE properties, with an explicit timezone and anchor.

oneOf.description: Long-lived, read-only observation of the existing root conversation.
Owner-independent admission using Pi's durable request identity.
Native clients share the authenticated local/tailnet transport.
`/goal` for one selected conversation: show, set, pause or resume its objective.
One snapshot of the coordinator's live native work, joined with task and agent identity.
Observe a saved conversation without claiming its execution.
Admit input independently of any observing terminal's lifetime.

Import one checked ChatGPT export. The requesting client serves every history read
for this request from the package it checked; the coordinator never sees a path.

SourceCheckpoint.description: Opaque to the caller and meaningful only to the matching provider/account.

oneOf.description: Omitted namespaces discovers every configured Google account.

owner_filter.description: Exact repository owner partition; omitted preserves unfiltered intake.

oneOf.description: An authenticated Slack API CLI prefix, optionally through a read-only wrapper.

SourceCoverage.description:
Coverage concerns the adapter's documented polling window, not an archive of
everything visible to the account. Excerpts retain a source for deeper reads.

legacy_version.description:
An earlier producer identity that may deduplicate identical normalized
content. The consumer must retain the earlier original and its decision.

occurred_at.description: Provider message time in Unix milliseconds. Missing times retain admission order.

SourceScanProgress.description:
Safe progress for the frozen provider window, without calendar/chat IDs or
opaque cursors. Window bounds are Unix seconds; unknown counts stay unknown.

UtcMillis.description: An absolute instant that has the same exact representation in Rust and JS.

rex_instance_id.description:
`whoami.instance_id` of the Rex server that started this pane's process.
Rex restores a saved pane with a fresh shell under a new instance, so a
process in the pane is the worker terminal only under this instance.
Absent on a binding saved before this field, or made by an older host.
